description:
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will serve as a senior technical contributor and design leader, owning complex components/services, driving engineering standards, and influencing cross-team architecture and execution. You will help elevate quality, reliability, and speed-to-market. 
  
 Key Responsibilities 
 Drives team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test strategy acceleration, incident/root-cause analysis support), while establishing consistent validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team. 

 Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation. 

 Lead technical design and delivery of complex full-stack capabilities (Java/Spring Boot + React/Angular). 

 Drive event-driven patterns using Kafka (idempotency, retries, ordering, error handling). 

 Establish strong engineering practices (test strategy, automation, CI/CD quality gates, observability). 

 Own production excellence: incident reduction, RCA prevention, performance tuning, and operational readiness. 

 Mentor engineers and influence technical direction across squads and partner teams. 

  
 Required Qualifications 
 Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security. 

 Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices 

 Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience 

 Deep expertise in Java 8+ / Spring Boot, microservices, and React/Angular. 

 Strong Kafka/event-driven architecture experience (retries, idempotency, DLQ patterns, schema/versioning). 

 Experience with SQL databases with data modelling, query optimization, and performance tuning. 

 Strong NoSQL experience: Cassandra / DynamoDB / Elastic Search (data modeling, reliability, scale). 

 Strong experience with Cloud Foundry/AWS and CI/CD strategy and execution. 

 Demonstrated leadership in design reviews, mentoring, and cross-team technical alignment. 

 Ability to work with tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana for observability and monitoring  

 Experience building applications with resilient, highly available architectures, including consideration for failure modes, recovery, and operational readiness. 

 Working knowledge of secure engineering practices and designing to meet Cyber Security and Technology Control requirements (e.g., authentication/authorization, secure APIs, data protection, dependency hygiene). 

  
 Additional / Optional 
 Cross-team delivery leadership, PCI experience and AWS cert are pluses. 

 


 
 
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world’s most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
 

 
 

 We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.
